info.name: A Weapon Never Leaves Its Owner

descriptions.notStarted: As soon as you reach Level 70, #b#p1201000##k strikes up a conversation with you…
descriptions.inProgress: #p1201000# tells you that the polearm is acting strange once again and that it might be trying to tell you something. What's the problem this time? You'd better head over to #b#m140000000##k.
descriptions.completed: #p1201002# told you that a thief came to the island late one night and removed a Red Jade from his body! He asked you to catch the thief and told you that the thief headed toward #m140020300#...
